review_description: Matt and the team did a very neat installation of a Fronius, BYD and Aiko panel solar system, communication was excellent and follow up was exemplary, they even coped with 2 older solar systems in parallel with the new one I would recommend Eco Solar to anyone thinking of installing a system.

Matt made the quote process very straightforward. Although disrupted by the weather, the  installation was completed within the timeframe estimate. Explanation and aftercare has been very good, with Matt patiently answering all my questions.

We recently had a solar system and battery installed by Eco Solar Energy, and we couldn't be happier with the entire experience! From the initial quoting through to completion of installation, Matt was incredibly responsive, always ready to answer any questions we had and made the entire process smooth and stress-free. The installation was completed efficiently, and the team ensured everything was set up perfectly. It's clear that Matt and his crew take pride in their work and care about their customers. We’ve already noticed a reduction in our energy costs, and the peace of mind knowing we’re using sustainable energy is priceless. We highly recommend Matt and Eco Solar Energy to anyone looking for top-notch service and reliable solar solutions!

Matt & his crew did an excellent job installing my sigenergy battery. They were quick & efficient as well as being polite & friendly. A very professional job. Matt answered all my questions & the battery is working well. He gave a comprehensive rundown on how the system works.We already had the solar panels on the roof

Batteries added to existed solar system. Highly recommend Matt and team for professional and neat install.System running in one day, Ecosolar quote reasonable, compared to other companies who came higher for same system and installation. Gateway system allows future addition of more panels, car charger etc. Blackout backup on all home circuits. Would not hesitate to use this company for any future work.

Communication was great, very responsive to questions, amendments and requotes.Punctual, polite and cleaned up when installation  finished.Organised grid connection, explained components of system and helped setup monitoring app.System was tested and working before they left.Overall hassle free process. Highly recommend Matt and his team.

Eco Solar recently updated our old solar system, removing all the old components then installing new panels & a Sigen battery. Matt, Liam & Jeramey were very professional, polite & tidy. Matt took care of all the approvals keeping us informed during the entire process. We are very happy with the result & highly recommend Matt & his team.

Matt from Eco Solar Energy made the whole process from quoting for a new system through to installation and commissioning a very simple process.  Very happy with the Sigenergy system and new solar panels.I am very happy.
Matt was very patient and professional answered all my queries before the installation.

I recently had photovoltaic panels and an inverter installed by Matt Crealy from Eco Solar Energy Pty Ltd, and I couldn't be more pleased with the experience. Matt did an exceptional job from start to finish. He offered a very competitive price, which stood out from other quotes I received.His professionalism throughout the entire process was evident, and he was incredibly responsive to any questions or concerns I had along the way. Matt clearly knows his stuff and took the time to explain everything in detail, ensuring I was comfortable with the system and how it operates.Overall, I highly recommend Matt Crealy for anyone considering solar installation. The quality of his work, combined with his expertise and fair pricing, makes him an excellent choice!
They employ their own installers (the principal and his offsider), did it all in two days, stuck with their install times and price and very happy.  strongly recommend them.

The quote was delivered quickly, the rep actually got on the roof and measured to be certain of details, an other company would not get on the roof. Installation went smoothly a week after the quote. The team were polite, tidy and did what they said they would do. Customer service was first rate. Would strongly recommend them.
Great job done from the quoting through to tidying up at the end of the job. Excellent communication throughout the process. Couldn’t recommend them higher.
After holding off on solar finally bit the bullet and found the whole process simple and easy with Eco. Matt is very professional and up on all things solar

Matt was very professional, approachable and informative, right from the initial consult through to install. Matt was prompt, well mannered and very clean.I was shown what I needed to do and given the necessary documentation to pass on to my energy provider.I couldn't have asked for anything more.

Can’t say a bad word about Matt and his team. He was the only guy from a few different companies that actually came out climbed on my roof and helped give me the best system for my house with my budget. Speedy install and great customer service.Thanx againBrett

Matt Crealy installed a 18 panel of Jinko Solar Tiger Neo panels with a Sungrow residential inverter together with a Greencatch hot water diverter in May 2024.We obtained 5 quotes and based our decision on the following factors1. Local company and crew2. Extensive solar history3. Physical inspection of the site4. Knowledge of current development of products, rebates5. Prompt response to phone, emails6. Competitive quote7. No "hussles" and no "pushing"8. Awareness of and respect to strata environment, viz noise, access9. Set up to grid connection and energy company10.Precise install dateWe highly recommend EcoSolarEnergy and happy to answer questions from prospective clients upon a request from Matt. This is our initiative and not solicited by Matt.

Matt contacted my partner and I shortly after the quote request. He listened to our requirements, made time to visit and provided a realistic solution that expanded our system to the capacity of our existing Fronius inverter. Matt sourced panels compatible with our existing panels from Winaico. The installation went smoothly, the site was left clean and the service was professional and friendly.
